verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a self-contained sandbox that simulates production. The AI-native path is explicitly sandbox-aware: the local MCP server takes PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT=SANDBOX, a separate hosted sandbox MCP endpoint (mcp.sandbox.paypal.com) exists, and the toolkit docs advise always testing in sandbox to avoid real transactions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent workflows run cleanly against the sandbox, and deeper detail on sandbox account and test-data setup.
